author: The Infographics Show
description:
Disappearances in cursed forests, vampire corpses that looked too fresh to be dead, green children speaking an unknown language, dogs leaping from a bridge for no clear reason. These are the cases that refuse to stay buried.

From the Bennington Triangle and the Dyatlov Pass tragedy to Elisa Lam, the Woolpit children, and Europe’s vampire panic, this countdown dives into some of the darkest and most bizarre stories ever recorded. Some have rational theories, others still feel like they belong to another world.

If you like unsolved cases, supernatural legends, and the most insane mysteries ever documented, this one goes deep into the stories that still leave experts, skeptics, and believers arguing to this day.
